item.title: After the Grey List: What South Africa’s FATF Exit Changes, and What Comes Next
item.description: The Financial Action Task Force removed South Africa from its grey list on 24 October 2025, about 32 months after it was listed. This brief sets out what the exit changes, what it does not, and why the next FATF evaluation, which begins in 2026, matters more than the delisting itself.
